### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **25** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1028438748dfbb6a76a981a25310fe39c481fb2c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8de91a6569317c5903207ddc5ce5d8e6c867a611` — the merge of head `4edfb2fd9955470e9ef4e9ebca21584bf9fd4630` into base `1028438748dfbb6a76a981a25310fe39c481fb2c`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8de91a6569317c5903207ddc5ce5d8e6c867a611 && git checkout 8de91a6569317c5903207ddc5ce5d8e6c867a611
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 1028438748dfbb6a76a981a25310fe39c481fb2c 4edfb2fd9955470e9ef4e9ebca21584bf9fd4630 && git checkout -B drift-repro 1028438748dfbb6a76a981a25310fe39c481fb2c && git merge --no-ff 4edfb2fd9955470e9ef4e9ebca21584bf9fd4630

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1028438748dfbb6a76a981a25310fe39c481fb2c
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## 席位核对

**Shape and gates.** `l1-face --pr 37835`: one flag, judged below. Check-runs at 4edfb2fd99: 58 success, 10 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending; mergeable_state clean. 7 files, +184/-23. Not governed. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

**The flag is not a gap.** `driver-sql` and `plugin-list` change test files only. `packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts` changes a docblock only; no statement moves. Nothing these packages publish changes in behaviour. That is the same reading as `metadata-core`'s comment-only edit in #37795. The `@objectstack/objectql` patch is the changeset owed.

**Fixes is right, under the corrected acceptance.** Record 7209730357's N3 and N4 asked for two things.
- **N3.** `assertOrderByIsMaterializable` now filters with `isVirtualSearchField(schema.fields[f])` in place of `type === 'formula'`. That is the predicate the Data API door and the sortability projection read. `isVirtualSearchField` judges by `type` alone and `SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES` is `formula` alone, so no verdict changes today.
- **The new pin.** `engine-sort-door-agreement.test.ts` asks both doors for every member of `FieldType`, with no copied verdict table. It tells the Data API door's third verdict from its fourth by which field the refusal names. The ablation is real: with `SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES` widened to `formula` and `summary`, the spec rebuilt and the engine door reverted to the literal, the `summary` row goes red.
- **N4.** The six comments that named the retired `UNMATERIALIZED_SORT_TYPES` now name the predicate, including the stale pointer in `validate-sortable-fields.ts`. The Data API door's own note keeps the old name as a retirement pointer, which your correction on #37810 allows.
- The ledger of the other `formula` literals (driver-sql, driver-turso, `planFormulaProjection`, search-companion, plugin-audit) moved into the engine door's docblock, where it is now true. It was removed from the Data API door in #37785.

**Changeset, sentence by sentence.** `ObjectQL.find` and `findOne` refuse a sort by a computed type for direct callers: true. "Nothing changes for a caller": true, the set is `formula` alone. "A type added to the spec's set is refused at both doors together": true, the pin holds it.

**Contract review.** None owed: no `packages/spec/src/**`, no governed path, `Clause-②: no`.

**Landing:** not governed, ≤3000 lines, no narrowing. The area lands it. `Fixes` closes the card.
